entries.label: PID
entries.what: Perception–Imagination Distance is an experimental composite proxy for the gap between simulated perception features, behavioural consistency, and self-report.
entries.method: Weighted composite of neural proxy distance, behavioural distance, and uncertainty. The weights are fixed by the implementation, not estimated from a validation sample here.
entries.uncertainty: Model-dependent and experimental. It is not a neural measurement and has no validated clinical cut-off.
entries.cannot: Cannot establish imagery quality, diagnosis, treatment response, or a person's actual mental content.

entries.label: IQI
entries.what: Imagery Quality Index is an experimental composite proxy combining attention, engagement, behavioural consistency, and relaxation.
entries.method: Weighted composite with a confidence weighting. Higher values are treated as better within this prototype only.
entries.uncertainty: Model-dependent and experimental. The weights and confidence model require external validation.
entries.cannot: Cannot be presented as an imagery score, a clinical outcome, or a measure of consciousness.

entries.label: Attention stability
entries.what: A proxy derived from simulated or imported signal features plus self-report.
entries.method: Inverse theta/beta-style proxy blended with self-report. With the simulated provider it is an engineering signal, not EEG from a person.
entries.uncertainty: Depends on the signal provider. Simulated signals carry no neural evidence.
entries.cannot: Cannot diagnose attention, measure concentration objectively, or support a neurofeedback claim.

entries.label: Relaxation
entries.what: A relative alpha-band proxy blended with self-reported relaxation.
entries.method: Relative alpha proxy plus self-report. It is not a clinical relaxation or stress measure.
entries.uncertainty: Signal-provider dependent; no validated individual threshold.
entries.cannot: Cannot diagnose anxiety, measure stress clinically, or replace a physiological assessment.

entries.label: Imagery engagement
entries.what: A task-related engagement proxy blended with self-reported vividness.
entries.method: Parietal/gamma-style proxy from the active signal provider plus self-report.
entries.uncertainty: Simulated or imported features only; the mapping to engagement is experimental.
entries.cannot: Cannot show that a person is imagining a particular content or that training improved imagery.

entries.label: Fatigue
entries.what: A trend-based fatigue proxy combined with self-report and session duration.
entries.method: Theta/lower-alpha trend, self-reported fatigue, and elapsed time. It drives rest suggestions, not diagnosis.
entries.uncertainty: Thresholds are prototype safety heuristics, not clinically validated cut-offs.
entries.cannot: Cannot diagnose fatigue or a medical condition; safety prompts are not a substitute for clinical care.

entries.label: Curriculum level
entries.what: The current step in the prototype's adaptive staircase.
entries.method: A 3-up/1-down staircase over success thresholds for the proxy metrics.
entries.uncertainty: Staircase behaviour depends on the proxy model and the session's task performance.
entries.cannot: Cannot be interpreted as a skill grade, a clinical stage, or a validated learning trajectory.

entries.label: Calibration (Brier)
entries.what: A behavioural calibration score from confidence reports matched to later outcomes.
entries.method: Brier-style scoring of reported confidence against observed correctness. Lower is better.
entries.uncertainty: Depends on the number of trials and the task; sparse sessions are unstable.
entries.cannot: Cannot measure metacognitive ability in general or diagnose a metacognitive disorder.

entries.label: Discrimination threshold
entries.what: A behavioural discrimination estimate from a 2-AFC scene threshold task.
entries.method: Signal-detection summary of choices across difficulty levels; censoring and trial count are reported.
entries.uncertainty: Depends on the staircase, trial count, and model assumptions; wide intervals are common.
entries.cannot: Cannot measure imagery strength, a diagnosis, or a fixed personal trait.

entries.label: Self-reported vividness
entries.what: A subjective rating supplied by the participant after an imagery attempt.
entries.source: Imagery self-report task and session self-report panels
entries.method: A bounded ordinal rating. It is reactive to expectation, task demand, and scale use.
entries.uncertainty: Subjective and unblinded; no objective validation of the reported experience.
entries.cannot: Cannot be treated as an objective image quality measure or compared naively across people.

entries.label: Symbolic scene
entries.what: A procedural, symbolic scene graph used as a training and communication aid.
entries.method: Deterministic geometry and parameters derived from typed commands or stored versions.
entries.uncertainty: It is an authored scaffold, not a measurement of the person's imagery.
entries.cannot: Cannot reconstruct, decode, or display what a person is imagining.

entries.label: Scene diff
entries.what: A deterministic comparison of two scene graphs, with an explicit basis.
entries.method: Entity-level and scene-level added, removed, and changed rows; basis is stated as head or source version.
entries.uncertainty: Only reflects stored scene parameters. It does not capture intent or perceptual salience.
entries.cannot: Cannot explain why a change was made or whether a scene is better.

entries.label: System trace
entries.what: An ordered, read-only record of persisted studio events.
entries.method: One row per persisted event, deduplicated by sequence number; payload and typed commands are shown verbatim.
entries.uncertainty: Records what the system did, not why a person acted or what they experienced.
entries.cannot: Cannot be treated as an intention log or a neural/clinical explanation.

entries.label: Generated candidate
entries.what: A procedural variation proposed by the local candidate generator.
entries.method: Deterministic scene mutations under declared locks and a source version.
entries.uncertainty: A proposal, not a recommendation or a measurement of the person.
entries.cannot: Cannot be described as the system understanding, reading, or improving the person's imagery.

entries.label: Synthetic estimate
entries.what: An effect or simulation produced from synthetic participants or scenarios.
entries.method: A declared scenario, seed, and model. It is an engineering check of the analysis pipeline.
entries.uncertainty: Not human data, not a validation of IMAGINA, and not evidence of efficacy.
entries.cannot: Cannot support a claim about people, clinical benefit, or real-world effectiveness.

entries.label: Dataset readiness
entries.what: Local checks that a dataset is present, readable, and structurally complete.
entries.method: File-level readiness and validation flags reported by the local backend.
entries.uncertainty: Readiness is not scientific validation and does not imply a representative sample.
entries.cannot: Cannot establish that a dataset is suitable for a confirmatory analysis or a clinical claim.

entries.label: EEG validation status
entries.what: Local checks of event semantics and dataset alignment for an EEG validation workflow.
entries.method: Structural checks and reported counts from the local dataset pipeline.
entries.uncertainty: Validation coverage depends on the available files and annotations.
entries.cannot: Cannot be called neural decoding, BCI validation, or a clinical EEG analysis.

entries.label: First-person local preview
entries.what: A deterministic first-person scene preview composed from a text brief and a demo signal vector.
entries.method: Local seeded geometry, palette, fog, and camera. No image or video model is attached.
entries.uncertainty: The signal vector is a control surface, not a measurement. The scene is symbolic, not reconstructed imagery.
entries.cannot: Cannot be presented as diffusion output, neural decoding, or a view into what a person is imagining.

entries.label: Diffusion skybox lane
entries.what: A fail-closed contract and optional remote lane for generating an equirectangular environment texture.
entries.method: Text prompt plus 16 derived conditioning values and aesthetic controls are sent only after consent. Without a worker the lane is blocked and no job is created.
entries.uncertainty: No model is attached in this build. A future generated texture would be an aesthetic aid, not a measurement of imagery.
entries.cannot: Cannot be called imagery reconstruction, neural decoding, a validated imagery score, or evidence that the adaptive loop works.

entries.label: Claim ceiling
entries.what: The highest claim level this local prototype is allowed to make.
entries.method: A project-level policy enforced in UI copy and audits.
entries.uncertainty: A governance boundary, not a scientific result.
entries.cannot: Cannot be raised by a frontend feature, a synthetic result, or an unsupported study plan.

entries.label: Study plan
entries.what: A locally generated N-of-1 design and analysis plan.
entries.method: A structured plan with a lock, version, and hash. It is not executed or registered.
entries.uncertainty: The plan's quality depends on the assumptions the author declares.
entries.cannot: Cannot be called a registered report, ethics approval, or evidence of an effect.

entries.label: Allocation preview
entries.what: A deterministic preview of condition order for a declared seed and block design.
entries.method: Seeded block allocation shown before the plan is locked.
entries.uncertainty: A preview, not a randomization service or a guarantee of balance.
entries.cannot: Cannot validate a study, replace allocation concealment, or support inference by itself.
